content.text: If you're a digital creator trying to sell ebooks, courses, or software without relying on Stripe, PayPal, or Gumroad, you're likely aware that conventional platforms like these can restrict your online sales due to country-specific [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/payment-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-every-detail-you|Payment Solutions]]-solutions-zimbabwean-digital-sellers-stack-started-generating|payment]] processing regulations. For instance, in countries like Nigeria, Ghana, and Kenya, Stripe is not available, and Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which can be a significant loss for [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-creators-ghana-get-paid-online-everything-you|COREMERCH guide to creators]]. The exact infrastructure problem is that you need a way to collect cryptocurrency payments without getting locked out of the market or being forced to pay hefty platform fees. This is where COREMERCH comes in – a sovereign commerce infrastructure company that offers a range of tools to help you build, deploy, and scale a digital commerce stack without relying on restrictive payment processors.

This post is part of the COREMERCH infrastructure series. For the complete foundation — every component, every configuration step, and the full deployment sequence — read the pillar guide: How to Start Selling Digital Products with Crypto Payments at https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/everything-you-need-know-about-automated-digital-product-2. That guide covers the complete architecture that this post builds on.

content.text: What Each Option Actually Offers: Start digital

At COREMERCH, we offer three main products: The Sovereign Starter Stack ($97), The Edge Commerce Stack ($197), and The Sovereign Blueprint ($47). Each of these options provides a unique set of features and benefits, but they all share one common goal – to empower digital creators to sell their products without relying on Stripe or other restrictive payment processors. The Sovereign Starter Stack, for example, includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This stack is perfect for creators who want a simple and affordable way to start selling digital products without getting locked out of the market. On the other hand, The Edge Commerce Stack includes more advanced features like Cloudflare Pages, Supabase, and SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, making it ideal for creators who want to scale their digital commerce operations and enjoy more advanced security and automation features.
How They Handle Restricted Countries

One of the biggest advantages of COREMERCH's solutions is that they are designed to work in countries where Stripe, PayPal, and Gumroad are restricted. Our infrastructure is built to handle cryptocurrency payments directly, without relying on third-party payment processors, which means that you can sell your digital products to customers in any country, without worrying about getting locked out of the market. Our NOWPayments integration, for example, supports over 300 cryptocurrencies, including many popular options like USDT, Bitcoin, and Ethereum, which means that you can accept payments in the currency of your choice, without worrying about conversion rates or fees.
Payment Speed, Fees, and Real Costs

When it comes to payment speed, fees, and real costs, COREMERCH's solutions are designed to be faster, cheaper, and more efficient than traditional payment processors. With NOWPayments, for example, you can accept payments in real-time, without waiting for days or even weeks for your money to be transferred. And with fees as low as 0.5%, you can keep more of your hard-earned income, without sacrificing speed or reliability. In contrast, Gumroad charges 10% on every sale, which can be a significant loss for creators who rely on it for their digital commerce operations.
Automated delivery means the download link arrives before the buyer navigates away from the payment confirmation page.
Ownership, Automation, and Delivery

At COREMERCH, we believe that ownership, automation, and delivery are critical components of a successful digital commerce stack. That's why our solutions are designed to give you full ownership and control over your data, payment processing, and delivery infrastructure. With our Edge Commerce Stack, for example, you can automate delivery of your digital products using Cloudflare Workers, which means that you can focus on creating more products, without worrying about the technical details of delivery and automation.
Which Architecture to Choose Based on Your Situation

So, which architecture to choose based on your situation? If you're just starting out and want a simple and affordable way to start selling digital products, The Sovereign Starter Stack is the perfect choice. If you're looking to scale your digital commerce operations and enjoy more advanced security and automation features, The Edge Commerce Stack is the way to go. And if you're looking for a comprehensive guide to building, deploying, and scaling a sovereign digital commerce stack, The Sovereign Blueprint is the perfect resource.
How do I sell an ebook online without PayPal or Stripe?

The fastest path to your first sovereign digital product sale is a three-step process. First, create a NOWPayments account — configure your wallet addresses for USDT on Tron and Bitcoin as starting points, generate your API key, and set the webhook endpoint URL. Second, choose your stack: Stack 01 uses GitHub Pages plus Google Apps Script and takes most creators four to six hours following the Sovereign Blueprint at $47; Stack 02 uses Cloudflare Pages plus Workers plus Supabase and is deployed by COREMERCH in 48 hours with the Edge Commerce Stack at $197. Third, upload your product files, set your prices in USD, and run a complete mainnet test transaction before promoting.
Every digital file type — ebooks, fonts, presets, plugins, templates — works with the same automated delivery pipeline.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

Digital creators selling ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, and beats often reach this infrastructure question after hitting payout restrictions or platform policy problems on Gumroad, Payhip, or Lemon Squeezy. The difference with a sovereign stack is structural: there is no platform relationship to manage, no content policy to comply with, and no payout schedule to wait on. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 deploys the complete infrastructure in 48 hours under your own accounts. The Sovereign Blueprint at $47 documents the build process for creators who prefer to self-deploy. Both are available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Prepare your product files in delivery-ready format — PDF for ebooks, ZIP archives for multi-file products, exported files for Notion templates, OTF and TTF archives for font families. Set your prices in USD and let NOWPayments handle the crypto equivalent calculation automatically at transaction time. Deploy your stack and configure the product list with file paths, USD prices, and delivery settings. Configure your storefront with product pages and checkout flow. Test the checkout on both desktop and mobile — confirm QR codes generate correctly and live price feeds display accurately. Complete a real mainnet test transaction and confirm the delivery email arrives with a working download link. Check your order database and confirm the test transaction appears with all correct fields.
